authMethods.label: Project API key and secret key

usage.reason: The documentation lists no per-user last-active field, no audit log of account members, and no per-user report for account members. Event export and analytics endpoints describe end-user product data, not people holding seats on the Amplitude account.

evidence.quote: HTTP Basic authentication. Username is the project API key, password is the project secret key.
Look up users by Amplitude ID, device ID, user ID, or user ID prefix.
Rate limits for this endpoint are lower than other Dashboard REST endpoints.

assumptions: The documentation has NO endpoint that lists the members (seat holders) of an Amplitude account or organization. The users section is a non-working placeholder and will not return the account's people. It needs a human to supply the right endpoint or confirm that none exists.

The placeholder uses the user search endpoint, which looks up tracked end users, not account members. It needs a search term, so I used the letter 'a' as a prefix. The response list name 'matches' and the field 'user_id' were not shown in the source and are guesses.
No email, name, status, role, or created date fields could be confirmed, so they are left empty.
Usage is marked unavailable because no per-user last-active data for account members was documented.

The base URL is the US host https://amplitude.com. EU-resident accounts use https://analytics.eu.amplitude.com, which cannot be set as a variable under the rules, so EU accounts would need a separate setup.

Only the project API key and secret key (HTTP Basic) are listed. The MCP OAuth option is for the MCP server on a different host and was left out. The organization-level keys used for data subject access requests are also left out.
Rate limit numbers were not stated in the source, so they are left empty.
